data.name: Elemental Fist
data.description: You empower your strike with elemental energy

raw_tokens.value: You empower your strike with elemental energy

When you use Elemental Strike pick one of the following energy types: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. On a successful hit, the attack deals damage normally plus %1d6+%3 points of damage of the chosen type. You must declare that you are using this feat before you make your attack roll (thus a failed attack roll ruins the attempt). You may attempt an elemental fist attack %2 times per day, but no more than once per round.|ElementalFistDamage|ElementalFistUses|ElementalFistDamageBonus|!PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Internal,TYPE.ElementalFistChoice
